title: European Tourism Seasonality 2026 — LSG Research Note 01
description: Source-backed descriptive analysis of peak-versus-quiet-month tourism concentration across selected European markets using Eurostat tourist-accommodation statistics. Includes the Low Season Growth Peak-to-Trough Concentration Gap, a descriptive percentage-point calculation from published source data. The metric is not an official Eurostat indicator and does not represent property-level hotel performance.
notes: Prepared for a standalone Zenodo dataset deposit. License intentionally not preselected.
